column3: It explicitly places fire in their bellies and joins it to painful punishment, closely matching the focus's inward burning.
Its provision from above and below and community division do not clarify the punishment of inner organs and skins.
The warning about hidden hostility uses a different sense of inwardness and adds no punishment imagery.

Its human creation and resurrection signs provide only a broad local setting for bodily recompense.
